MaiCord 0.5.x and 0.6.x install this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes.

### Highlights

- **Smoother changes.** Switching themes, and a time-of-day theme moving between day and night, now glide smoothly, frame by frame. Effect knobs ease to their new values too. Reduced motion keeps every change instant.
- **The Friends page follows your theme.** Its column shows the background effect and gradient like the chat does, with the same tabs and search field as the Inbox.
- **Silk Waves 1.3.1 in the catalog.** Its month and day/night changes ease over about a second, and the Glare knob now does something: 0 turns the glow off and higher values make the ribbon's bright folds bloom, at night too.
- **Smooth scrolling in Plugins, Themes and Effects.** These pages now ease like the rest of Settings when you use the wheel, touchpad or paging keys.
- **Fixes.**
  - A crash when going back to Settings > Updates after visiting Plugins, Themes or Effects.
  - The title bar no longer flickers when switching Settings pages.
  - Ctrl image zoom no longer works on a message image hidden behind Settings, a popup or a panel.
  - A development copy of an effect that the catalog also lists now opens its own page and knobs.

### Other

- Scroll the store pages through the shared scroll animator
- Clear the Updates rows when the page frees their text
- Stop Settings page switches flashing the caption bar
- Start the image zoom only over an uncovered message image
- Theme the Friends page like the chat view
- List development effects beside catalog items with the same slug
- Glide theme and knob changes once per frame

MaiCord 0.5.x and 0.6.x install this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes.

### Highlights

- **The Silk Waves theme follows the effect's knobs.** While Silk Waves is your background, a month or Day or Night picked on its knob page holds the theme on that month or phase too, with the same smooth change.
- **Knob choices that fit.** A choice on an effect's knob page shows as buttons sized to their labels while they fit, and as a dropdown when the window is too narrow. Silk Waves' choices are shorter: Clock, Night when dark, Day and Night.
- **Fixes.**
  - "Show spoiler content" in Settings no longer overlaps in narrow windows; its third option is now "Moderated".

### Other

- Let themes follow their effect's knobs and fit knob choices

MaiCord 0.5.x and 0.6.x install this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes.

### Highlights

- **Themes that follow the time of day.** A theme can now change with the clock and the month, and switch between light and dark on its own; the change fades in smoothly.
- **Silk Waves theme.** A new theme in Settings > Themes to pair with the Silk Waves effect: dark at night and in the early morning, light through the day, coloured from the same month palettes as the sky.
- **Readable Silk Waves on dark themes.** With "Follow the clock", Silk Waves keeps its night sky whenever MaiCord or Windows is dark, so text over it stays readable. The day-only option is now labelled for light themes.
- **Catalog.** MaiCord reads a newer catalog index that can list items needing future versions as "Needs a newer MaiCord" instead of hiding them.

### Other

- Give the showcase's /release reply a newer ID than the GIF before it
- Let themes change with the time of day and month
- Read a forward-compatible catalog index

MaiCord 0.5.x and 0.6.x install this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes.

### Highlights

- **Silk Waves.** A new background effect in Settings > Effects: a ribbon of light over a month-tinted sky with drifting glitter, inspired by the PS3 menu background. It follows the time of day and your light or dark appearance.
- **Effects on light themes.** Background effects no longer vanish on light themes: their light turns into soft shade, keeping its colours, and switching themes cross-fades. Turn it off globally or per effect under "Light themes".
- **Faster effects.** Aurora, Bokeh, Plasma, Starfield and Wave lines use 15–83 % less GPU time and look the same.
- **More capable effects.** Effects can follow the clock and the light or dark appearance, and draw in several passes with meshes, particles and state that carries between frames. The effect guide covers both.
- **Attachment size in errors.** A file over the upload limit now says how big it is, for example "video.mp4 is 27.3 MB, over the 10 MB limit."
- **Fixes.**
  - The status pill on an effect's live preview is readable over dark effects.
  - Effects that need a newer MaiCord show "Needs a newer MaiCord" instead of failing to install.

### Features

- Show the file's size when an attachment is over the limit

### Performance

- Speed up the sample effects

### Other

- Adapt effects to light themes and keep preview pills readable
- Read the full catalog index with effect interface levels
- Let effects declare pass graphs with targets, vertex grids and state
- Give effects opt-in clock and appearance inputs

MaiCord 0.5.x and 0.6.x install this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes.

### Highlights

- **Plugin cards look like real embeds.** Cards such as Translate's share the embed's surface and full-height accent bar, with actions like Hide as footer links. Hiding a card no longer leaves an empty gap under the message.
- **Messages only you can see show an eye icon.** Plugin messages and private bot replies read "Only you can see this • Dismiss message".
- **Live effect previews.** Every installed effect plays live on its page in Settings > Effects, not only the one you're using.
- **Plugin information dialogs.** Plugins can show read-only text in a dialog with a single Close button (plugin API level 3). Permissions Viewer and View Raw use it in their catalog updates.
- **Fixes.**
  - The Installing spinner animates and no longer covers the button's text.
  - Video, audio and poll labels such as "Playback unavailable" no longer show through the "You're viewing older messages" bar, and the unread banner's text no longer shows through the pinned, search and requests panels.
  - A plugin dialog with no button label shows OK, as documented.

### Features

- Add read-only text and info dialogs to the plugin API (level 3)

### Other

- Render plugin cards as embeds and collapse them when hidden
- Draw timeline media controls under the timeline overlays
- Preview every installed effect live on its detail page
- Animate store busy buttons and keep their spinner off the label

MaiCord 0.5.x and 0.6.0 install this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes.

### Highlights

- **One scrollbar everywhere.** Every list, panel and popup now uses the thin scrollbar from Settings, which widens when you point at it or drag it.
- **Leaner.** About 3,900 lines of code are gone, and the executable shrinks from 6.50 to 6.48 MB.
  - Animated text and nameplates no longer ask Windows for the animation setting every frame.
  - Opening a lossless WebP uses 32 KiB less memory.
- **Fixes.**
  - Changing an effect setting whose lowest and highest values are the same no longer produces an invalid value.
  - The Effects page's Performance defaults card shows your real settings.
  - Theme pages show their text contrast rating.
  - The clear button in the store's search box highlights under the pointer.
  - Toasts follow the Windows animation setting, like the rest of MaiCord.
  - A failed Gateway send no longer leaves part of the message it was writing in memory.
- **Removed.**
  - The effect install dialog's "View .hlsl" row, which did nothing.
  - Plugin website approvals are no longer written to a second file that nothing read, so switching a website on or off can no longer fail because of it.

### Fixes

- Fix store knob steps, performance defaults, contrast and clear hover

### Other

- Remove the GPU timing diagnostics
- Use the expanding overlay scrollbar everywhere
- Follow the system animation setting in toasts
- Remove the effect install dialog's View .hlsl row
- Drop approval.bin; host approvals persist in catalog-state.bin
- Use commit_pages for committed VirtualAlloc sites
- Refresh the README for 0.6.0
- Read the cached animation setting in the renderer and member media
- Share duplicated helpers and drop dead plumbing and test-only seams
- Wipe the Gateway payload after a failed command write
- Clean up test, benchmark and build infrastructure
- Remove unused Win32 and SDK declarations
- Drop unused layout features and dead shell APIs
- Simplify ANSI, timestamp and secure-edit text code
- Use memmove gap helpers in chat and user stores
- Use sorted gap helpers in guild stores and drop alias prechecks
- Share the profile application cache and drop dead auth checks
- Drop unread decoder counters and share slot-index probing
- Drop FIR keyframe requests and the always-false gap flag
- Remove the vestigial Gateway client identity and dead fields
- Share media cache probes and attachment URL checks
- Internalize single-use chat UI helpers
- Drop redundant zeroing and share text-store geometry in chat
- Trim dead state and duplicates in effects and themes
- Remove the UiKit API nothing but tests used
- Simplify settings code and drop unreachable guards
- Trim dead store model state and share store builders
- Trim dead state and duplicates from the plugin host

MaiCord 0.5.x installs this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes.

### Highlights

- **Plugins.** MaiCord now has a plugin system and an official catalog of reviewed plugins: Settings > Plugins.
  - 27 plugins at launch, including Message Logger, Translate, Clear URLs, Platform Indicators, Typing Indicator, Quick Reply, Message Click Actions, Permissions Viewer, Server Info, View Raw, Text Replace, Silent Typing, No Reply Mention, Send Timestamps, Custom RPC and Last.fm Rich Presence.
  - Every catalog plugin is built from its public source and signed. Before a plugin runs, you see and approve what it may do and which websites it may contact. Plugins never see your token.
  - Plugins install, update, roll back and turn on or off without a restart.
- **Themes and background effects.** You can browse and install themes and animated backgrounds from Settings > Themes and Settings > Effects, or from a `maicord://` link.
  - Seven new themes, and seven effects: ASCII rain, aurora, starfield, plasma, soft bokeh, wave lines and film grain.
  - Settings > Themes lists every installed theme, imported files included: Apply applies one in a click, and Import theme… adds a theme file. Appearance shows your themes next to the built-in ones, and going back to a built-in theme restores the one you had, not Dark. Editing an installed theme keeps the original and saves an edited copy.
  - Effects render at reduced resolution, pause when MaiCord is hidden or idle, and stay within a GPU budget. You can raise or lower the resolution and frame rate globally or per effect.
- **New built-in features.**
  - **Image zoom:** a magnifier lens. Hold Ctrl over an image in chat, or press and hold in the image viewer; scroll to zoom.
  - **Role colours** on mentions, voice participants and typing names.
  - **Reply timestamps** on reply previews.
  - **Server folders:** opening one folder closes the others.
  - **Hidden channels** are listed with a lock and a summary of who can see them. Nothing is fetched from them.
- **Redesigned settings.**
  - Grouped cards, segmented controls and dropdowns replace long radio lists.
  - A cleaner sidebar and close button.
  - The Updates page shows what's new in your version and the next one.
- **Sharper, steadier text.** Letters are placed on quarter pixels so word spacing follows the font, and text no longer shimmers while the window is resized.
- **Smaller.** The executable shrinks from 6.69 to 6.49 MB even with all of the above.
- **For developers.**
  - Plugins are written in C or C++ against the documented SDK, with guides at maicord.com/plugins/develop and maicord.com/effects/develop.
  - `tools/maicord-plugin` creates, builds, checks and packs plugins and effects. Developer Mode reloads them as you rebuild and shows their log in a console.
- **Fixes.**
  - Pressing Check now in Settings no longer moves the focus to the search box.
  - Hovering a segmented setting highlights the option under the pointer.
  - The Updates status line wraps cleanly, and its note no longer mentions a separate account module.

### Features

- Add plugin API level 2 for the catalog ports
- Add the plugin, theme and effect catalog client and the redesigned settings
- Add plugin v2 surfaces, background effects and six built-in features
- Show the compact rail, folders and /gif in the website showcase
- Add plugin ABI 6: one-descriptor C ABI, C++ authoring layer and runtime core

### Fixes

- Fix store page input and focus rings, and manage themes in Themes
- Fix the settings segment hover, the Updates status wrap and its footnote
- Restore three hot paths the size pass slowed

### Other

- Allocate the theme catalog scan workspace as one structure
- Keep installed themes intact when built-in gradient settings change
- Wire the plugin action table when the runtime opens
- Offer ALPN http/1.1 on the HTTP/1.1 transport
- Keep a gap between adjacent menu row plates
- Trust the published plugin catalog keys by default
- Fade and scale everything in Settings as one layer
- Accept four false-positive CodeQL findings in the baseline
- Expect the SDK header's API level from a default-built plugin
- Keep the Gateway dispatch, voice and media glue at /O2
- Place glyphs on quarter pixels so word spacing follows the font
- Snap text blocks to whole device pixels as a unit
- Cut another 63 KB: zero-default structs, shared sorts and tables, packed emoji
- Cut 262 KB from the client: packed data, cold code for size, leaner call sites
- Remove ABI 5 and add plugin developer tools, store previews and settings polish
- Keep the response-scratch overwrite out of the scroll text timing
- Keep settings focus in place when the focused control goes away

MaiCord 0.5.x installs this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes.

### Highlights

- **Much lighter on the GPU.**
  - The Stars and Comets background costs about 20× less GPU time, so an idle window uses about half the GPU it did.
  - Scrolling the emoji picker is far cheaper: dragging the scrollbar fast went from about 9.5 ms to under 1 ms of GPU time per frame, and scrolling back no longer redraws emoji.
  - Text appears faster the first time it is drawn, and spoiler blur costs half as much.
- **Smaller.** The executable shrinks from 6.91 to 6.69 MB.
- **`/gif` and `/sticker` send on Enter.** Enter sends the highlighted or first result, waiting for results that are still loading, instead of shaking.
- **Compact mode closer to the official client.** The server rail, channel list, message display, channel row hover and selection, and the picker rails match its layout.
- **Fixes.**
  - Right-click menus open under the pointer.
  - Create Event explains when a server has no stage or voice channel to pick.
  - Playlist titles stay correct after scrolling away and back.
  - Video embeds from providers get a play and open-in-browser button, and embed frames fit their poster's shape.
  - Sharp corners, such as the window buttons, no longer show a grey blotch.
  - `/shrug` and text commands send exactly what you typed.
- **Plugins load faster** when none are installed, and builds now ship with the official plugin catalog configured.

### Features

- Add a declarative UI scene kit and move 23 scenes onto it
- Show an empty-state notice when Create Event has no stage or voice channel to pick

### Performance

- Split test_main.cpp, the UI probe and the large test and perf sources

### Other

- Build clients with the official plugin catalog keys
- Send the first GIF or sticker result on Enter instead of shaking
- Cache plugin decoration lookups and skip empty slot surfaces in UI rows
- Reduce plugin SDK hooks to one check when no plugin is enabled
- Make plugin loading and the catalog cheaper and merge duplicate helpers
- Pack generated data with an optimal deflate search
- Check every present against a full render of the same state
- Follow a dragged emoji picker thumb once per presented frame
- Batch emoji and glyph rasterization and grow the atlas under pressure
- Cut UI, glyph and media shader work
- Draw built-in stars and comets as instanced sprites
- Keep the forum test adapter's attachment views alive after submit
- Prune split-part includes and tidy names and leftovers after the layout move
- Split the largest sources into topic files
- Move sources and tests into topic folders
- Cut header fan-out and start the client link earlier
- Generalize protocol writers, account plumbing and settings modals
- Shrink cold codegen, drop redundant synchronization and test-only APIs
- Outline size-compiled code and compile more cold code for size
- Remove dead code, test-only production APIs and unused includes
- Derive main-window state from messages and share overlay input handling
- Send a text command's option value, not its chip text
- Render the shrug face verbatim and match the escape rule's whitespace class
- Theme hairline separators through one shared colour
- Keep the picker rail's focus ring to keyboard navigation
- Inset the picker rails and inspector bar as rounded cards
- Draw the outline invite and settings glyphs in channel rows
- Match channel row hover and selection to the client
- Match the channel list to the client's compact layout
- Match the server rail to the client's compact layout
- Match the compact message display to the client
- Give provider video embeds a play and open-in-browser pill
- Refit an embed frame to its decoded poster's own aspect
- Give DefWindowProc the client pointer so right-click menus open under the pointer
- Keep playlist title and track text valid when scrolled out of view

MaiCord 0.5.x installs this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes.

### Highlights

- **Faster Gateway.**
  - Bursts of messages are processed about 40% faster, and READY about 30% faster.
- **Steadier connections.**
  - TLS reconnects resume the previous session, so the handshake takes 5.2 ms instead of 10.8 ms.
  - Idle connections reconnect cleanly instead of failing the first request after a quiet spell.
- **Lighter on memory and disk.**
  - Chat state uses less memory, and the executable shrinks from 6.98 to 6.91 MB.
- **Faster image thumbnails.**
  - WebP thumbnails decode 43% faster, and JPEG thumbnails up to 17% faster.
- **Closer to the official client.**
  - Slowmode is tracked per channel.
  - Reconnect backoff follows the official client.
  - Pinned messages load in pages of 25.
  - Bulk bans stop at the API's limit of 200 users.
- **Server tag icons no longer draw over the channel header.**

### Fixes

- Fix a crash on Lottie outlines with no valid bounds
- Fix the status line failing text layout

### Performance

- Vectorise the CPU thumbnail decoders and share the deflate tables
- Prune SDK declarations, speed up memmove and compile media decoders for size
- Speed up ETF and JSON string handling and cut chat model revalidation
- Speed up JSON scanning and match the client on settings timing and login_source

### Other

- Clip message header tags and chips to the message viewport
- Share one Schannel credential across connections so reconnects resume the TLS session
- Remove code only tests read and link more tests into shared bundles
- Keep rich message items in recycled side blocks and hash channel batch duplicates
- Shrink TLS and Gateway buffers and answer READY from its structural index
- Retry opt-in GETs, send the User-Agent on downloads and release retired TLS buffers
- Index the Gateway's JSON while transcoding ETF and follow visible guild users
- Decode gateway dispatches from the frame index and match the client on slowmode and acks
- Page pins at 25, close idle REST connections early and cap bulk bans at 200
- Track slowmode per channel and decode message pages from their structural index
- Animate the showcase hero
- Prune redundant comments added since 0.5.0
- Remake the website showcase
- Require AES-NI and drop the GCM64 fallback

MaiCord 0.5.x installs this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes.

### Highlights

- **Lighter voice calls.**
  - Voice decoding is 11–25% faster, and encoding 4–17% faster, with identical audio.
  - End-to-end encrypted (DAVE) audio frames decrypt about 3× faster and encrypt about 2× faster, using the processor's AES instructions when available.
  - Joining and updating encrypted calls takes less work: group changes are about 20% faster.
- **Slash command picker fixes.**
  - The category rail follows your theme, including gradient backgrounds.
  - Apps without a bot avatar, such as Wordle, show their app icon in the picker and in the command bar.

### Performance

- Speed up Opus and the voice audio path

### Other

- Slim DAVE and MLS and run DAVE AES-GCM with AES-NI
- Theme the command picker rail and show app pictures like the client
- Copy the bundled fonts once instead of racing per-target copies
